scorecard.note: The beats read off figures (10 starts, 50%, 78 GW) without a stake for the viewer, so the story is weak. The hook promises a contrarian twist ('Someone forgot to tell China'), but beat 1 only says '10 reactors started', with no sense of sca

storyboard.ears: Everyone said nuclear was dead. Someone forgot to tell China.
Builders started 10 nuclear reactors worldwide. Construction is growing rather than disappearing.
storyboard.evidence: International Energy Agency (IEA) | New nuclear reactor construction starts worldwide per year | https://www.iea.org/reports/global-energy-review-2026/technology-nuclear | 2026-11-01

storyboard.ears: China holds 50 percent of nuclear capacity under construction. One country drives half the buildout.
storyboard.eyes: substance: wet grey concrete; cause: Data pours buckets of concrete from each tower's top deck and the wall rises lift by lift
storyboard.evidence: International Energy Agency (IEA) | Share of global nuclear capacity under construction, by country | https://www.iea.org/reports/global-energy-review-2026/technology-nuclear | 2026-11-01

storyboard.ears: About 78 gigawatts of nuclear capacity is under construction. Tomorrow's power supply is already taking shape.
storyboard.evidence: International Energy Agency (IEA) | Nuclear capacity under construction worldwide vs one typical reactor | https://www.iea.org/reports/global-energy-review-2026/technology-nuclear | 2026-11-01

storyboard.ears: The supposedly dying industry is quietly shaping tomorrow's electricity supply.
